h1: The 6 Best Mini PC Monitor Mounts of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Mini PC Monitor Mounts: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six mini PC monitor mounts for VESA backs and monitor arms, with weight ratings and width ranges compared.
summary: The 12 lb adjustable thin client mount for monitor arms is the best all-rounder under $25. The HumanCentric bracket adds a combined 18 lb rating with a monitor, the VIVO adjustable has a 3-year warranty, and the VIVO Dell mount hides an OptiPlex Micro behind the screen.
intro: Strapping a mini PC to the back of a monitor frees desk space, but the trap is weight. Your monitor's VESA pattern is rated for the monitor alone, so adding a PC can push the combined load past what a thin arm will hold.
We reviewed mounts on the listed VESA patterns, device width range, weight capacity and ventilation. Six made the list, ranked by how safely and widely each fits.

products.name: Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC Mount Bracket, Attached to Monitor Arm
products.verdict: A metal bracket that fits 0.63 to 2.8 inch devices and carries 12 lb.
products.description:
This metal bracket fits devices from 0.63 to 2.8 inches wide, carries 12 lb and mounts to a monitor arm, wall or under a desk. It adds cable management and a pen holder, all under $25.

It ranks first for the combination of width range, 12 lb capacity and price. Against HumanCentric, it has a higher device rating but no combined rating with the monitor.

It suits most mini PCs. Check your monitor arm's remaining load.
products.idealFor: Most mini PCs on monitor arms.
products.skipIf: Your arm is near its limit.

products.name: HumanCentric Thin Client Mount Bracket, Mini PC to Monitor Arm
products.verdict: The only bracket here with a stated combined rating alongside the monitor.
products.description:
The HumanCentric bracket is compatible with VESA 75x75 and 100x100mm, fits 0.65 to 2.55 inch depth, carries 11 lb and lists 18 lb combined with the monitor. It ships with silicone scratch strips and wall and under-desk hardware, at $25-50.

It ranks second because the combined rating is rare and useful. Against the cheaper 12 lb bracket, it fits a narrower range.

It suits heavier monitors.

products.name: VIVO Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC Mount, Attached to Monitor
products.description:
The VIVO is solid powder-coated steel with VESA 75x75 and 100x100mm, a 1.8 to 7.1 cm width, a 5 kg (about 11 lb) rating and a 3-year warranty. It is priced under $25.

It ranks third because the 12 lb pick holds more and fits wider. Against HumanCentric, it is cheaper with a longer warranty.

It suits buyers who want backing.

products.name: VIVO Behind Monitor Mini PC Mount for Dell OptiPlex Micro
products.verdict: A ventilated mount that conceals a Dell OptiPlex Micro behind the screen.
products.description:
The VIVO mount is purpose-built for Dell OptiPlex Micro with VESA 75x75 and 100x100mm, a concealed behind-screen attachment and a ventilated open structure. Desk and wall hardware are included, and it is listed under $25.

It ranks fourth because it only fits one device family. Against the universal brackets, it holds a Dell more rigidly.

It suits OptiPlex Micro owners.

products.name: Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC Mount, Attach to Monitor Arm and Stand
products.verdict: An open-frame metal mount that also attaches to a stand pole.
products.description:
This open-frame metal mount fits 0.63 to 2.8 inch widths, holds 12 lb and mounts to a monitor arm, stand pole, wall or under desk. Cable management and a pen holder come included, under $25.

It ranks fifth because it mirrors the top pick, with a stand pole option and open airflow. Against it, the specs are nearly identical.

It suits monitor stands.

products.name: Monzlteck Adjustable Small Device VESA Mount Behind the Monitor
products.verdict: A simple steel mount with a 2-screw install.
products.description:
The Monzlteck is steel, fits devices under 2.8 inches thick, mounts behind the monitor, on a wall or under a desk, has anti-scratch EVA pads and a 2-screw install. It costs under $25.

It ranks last because no weight rating is listed. Against the 12 lb brackets, it is plainer.

It suits a light mini PC.

whatMatters.detail: The monitor arm and VESA plate have limits. Adding a PC adds to them. Check monitor weight plus PC weight against the arm.
75x75 and 100x100mm are the common patterns. Your monitor must match. Check the back of the monitor.
The bracket must fit your PC thickness. Check the listed range.
A PC behind a monitor can run warm. Open frames help. Check vents.
Simple installs save time. Check hardware included.
